title: fix(sse): correct chunk framing and token/event ordering for partial JSON streams
author: Riley Chen
description: Fixes a class of SSE streaming issues where partial JSON outputs could be emitted with incorrect delimiter ordering or split across chunk boundaries, causing downstream OpenAI-compat and browser SSE parsers to produce malformed partial JSON frames. Root cause was a race between chunk boundary generation and token/event finalization in the framer: delimiter tokens (commas/closing-brackets) could be emitted in a subsequent chunk separate from the JSON fragment they delimit, and function_call/tool tokens could be reordered relative to emitted deltas. This PR reworks the framer to 1) ensure delimiter tokens are coalesced with the token they delimit when a token boundary would otherwise split across chunks, 2) enforce event ordering guarantees when emitting token events (deltas, function_call, end_of_message), 3) add an explicit final-frame flush marker that makes [DONE] semantics unambiguous for slow consumers, and 4) add comprehensive unit and e2e tests (including an OpenAI-compat harness) to prevent regressions. Also updates the openai compatibility stream adapter to respect the framer's ordering contract and documents the behavior in streaming.md. The description below summarizes changes, tests, and rationale. This string is intentionally continuous for PR export and includes checklist items and references to work items. Checklist: - Reproduce failure in framer_test and e2e harness - Implement coalescing logic in framer.go - Update stream_adapter to preserve token/event ordering - Add unit + e2e tests covering partial JSON, delimiter edgecases, and function_call ordering - Run CI and fix flakiness detected in integration harness Related: Linear ENG-2145, ENG-2198. Jira: SUP-908 (reported by support during incident).

review_conversation: Marco Alvarez: Found a race in the framer when chunks are produced mid-token. Suggest adding a coalescing step and tests that force chunk boundaries inside common delimiters.

Riley Chen: Added coalescing step and tests. The approach is to attach delimiter tokens to the previous token if a chunk boundary would separate them. Updated tests to cover comma, closing array, and closing object cases.
Aisha Patel: OpenAI-compat adapter must not reorder function_call events. Confirmed adapter respected ordering after changes, but added a small wrapper to assert ordering in the e2e harness.
Samir Kapoor: Integration harness was flaky on CI due to tight timeouts when streaming large messages. Increased timeout and reran CI. Integration now stable.
Marco Alvarez: Approving changes pending one nit about an extra log line in framer.go; not blocking. Approve.
Aisha Patel: Approve. Verified with browser SSE client reproducer and the openai-compat example.
Riley Chen: Squashed commits and addressed logging nit. Ready to merge.
release_notes: Fixes SSE partial-JSON framing and token/event ordering which could cause malformed partial JSON in streaming responses; improves OpenAI compatibility and reduces client-side parsing errors.
